context_files.purpose: Visibility, taint, reset, and sterility contract.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal is a finite synthetic test of whether frozen, target-blind prospective/revision text memory can turn an arm's own public action-outcome history into later D4 action value after native raw history is exceeded. Its distinctive causal evidence is not mere later performance: assigned authentic/twin/null memory must redirect a probe, the assigned object is unmounted, only public branch evidence may reach a target-blind compiler, and the resultant delta is used in a sterile later target. This can support a bounded offline-compilation advantage only if generic SELF beats every strongest permitted non-SELF common-history representation and loses under registered outcome and semantic interventions. It cannot establish generic learning-rate superiority, autonomous discovery, compression, a learned controller, unbounded learning, or even broad graph discovery.
graph_delta_interpretation: Relative to fixed-source PCFL-Stream, the proposal adds an on-policy opportunity-to-action-to-public-evidence path and a randomized fork: M_auth/twin/null -> probe A -> ordinary outcome O -> unmount/reset -> common authentic prior plus target-blind delta D -> sterile later action Y. It also adds a representation sentinel on byte-identical histories, nonadaptive-versus-recurrent read separation, binding-only and same-probe outcome interventions, and semantic-cut/sham comparisons. These make direct assigned-memory replay and simple one-event/keyed-witness explanations falsifiable, but they do not prove that the model discovered a reusable abstraction: the family, action grammar, event extractor, candidate construction, resolver, and certified target graph are supplied. Cross-era success remains adaptive retrieval/composition over a finite causal map.
loop_delta_interpretation: Each arm now has its own growing ordinary life under common presealed opportunities, rather than replaying a common source trajectory. Checkpoints at .75L, 1.5L, 3L, and 6L separate pre-native reference from post-native NEW/OLD/CROSS targets; evaluation is sterile. The randomized 1.5/3/6L fork isolates an information-seeking pulse, while the 3L same-event/common-history lanes isolate representation and compiler content. This is a credible architecture loop only after total target allocation, strict age/unique-information rules, pre-model cognition freeze, and all unmount/taint checks actually pass. Otherwise it is a carefully instrumented memory/retrieval benchmark with no warranted continual-learning interpretation.
claim_delta_interpretation: C1 is defensible only as an executed-action advantage of the frozen generic text compiler over the strongest recurrent/raw/mechanical/linked/rolling common-history comparator under the fixed online envelope, with all offline work reported. C2 is a randomized chain-complete causal-cascade contrast, explicitly not formal mediation. C3 needs the 26-root IUT over P1-P4 and therefore cannot be claimed from construct fixtures or eight-root DEV. A4 efficacy is descriptive for C1-C3 and cannot be presented as a revision result; LoRA is not applicable and cannot be used to enlarge the text paper. A baseline can be called plateaued only on its own two equivalence intervals, so the owner-level expectation that competitors saturate is a hypothesis, not a premise or likely conclusion.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The declared separation is unusually strong and benchmark-essential: targets/scorer/hidden truth/evaluation outcomes/prior results and assignment metadata are barred from positive memory; branch assignment memory ends at the probe; post-unmount only public A/O descendants can feed D; evaluation goal queries are ephemeral; and the DEV selector has one-way aggregate flow. The central residual risk is implementation complexity: cache state, candidate construction/order, timestamps, errors, policy retries, provider seeding, raw-history truncation, and treatment-derived filenames can reintroduce a channel. Mutation tests must exercise semantic as well as metadata channels and prove paired compiler equality from actual emitted inputs, not merely from a seed function review.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 must demonstrate a total, non-performance-conditioned opportunity/target generator and real growth; otherwise later failures can be selection artifacts. T02 is the key construct gate: a legal world/action target, unique D4 proof, low target-only headroom, and failure of the byte-identical nonadaptive atom reader are all needed; recurrent KV/linked/raw/MECH success is allowed and becomes a serious comparator rather than a benchmark failure. T03 operationalizes the whole causal chain with all three clones, common pre-fork compiler draws, unmount/reset, cumulative failure-zeroed links, and binding/outcome tests; it supports a cascade only, never formal mediation. T04 requires the precommitted generic compiler and target-blind semantic/outcome cuts to distinguish incremental SELF content from supplied witness replay. T05 requires honest raw-context/RAG, both native AS-EXT candidates, recurrent and nonadaptive KV, MECH, generic SELF, and labeled class-informed ceiling; the primary benchmark comparison must remain root-wise strongest rather than a selected loser. T06 correctly treats twin-pair root as n, but its P1 minimum is a hard, discrete, dependent composite and the frozen simulation/SD gate is a feasibility screen, not assurance that 26 roots will yield persuasive precision. T07 and T12 are prerequisites for interpreting every positive contrast: actual cognition bytes, CRN encoding, provider seed conversion, metadata closure, cache/reset and sterility mutants must be frozen and independently reproduced before scientific calls. T08 makes the proposed September product construct plus labeled eight-root DEV only; no Stage-C evidence may be implied before the full 26x908 roster, 520-H100-equivalent/6.5-TB and calendar locks fit without pruning. T09 properly limits current A4 to row/scoring/sterility integrity; weak or strong revision diagnostics cannot change C1-C3. T10 is correctly NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D for text, so LoRA absence is neither a text failure nor evidence. T11 requires a fresh evidence-to-claim audit with a genuinely negative/null option. Overall recommendation: REWORK BEFORE HUMAN RATIFICATION. The benchmark has a potentially meaningful, falsifiable narrow target, but ratification should require operational proof plans for generator-independent construct validity, total-resource comparability, and the non-Gaussian/min-composite inference feasibility before any implementation or model-call authority.
assumptions: The presealed worlds and exact typed controller can genuinely certify target-only headroom, D4 minimum depth, and failure of all relevant nonadaptive strategies without encoding the desired winner.
The generic prompt, supplied event extractor, candidate catalog, reader APIs, and semantic-cut algorithm can be frozen without PCFL-family-specific sufficient join strategies.
Common online caps plus full reporting of offline work are enough for the intended claim, which is value under an online envelope rather than compute efficiency or fair total-compute equality.
The 26 roots are exchangeable independent world-life draws and completion failures are assigned identically across arms rather than becoming asymmetric availability artifacts.

The frozen simulator can represent the distribution induced by bounded zero-heavy minima and all meaningful dependencies well enough to justify use of the planned t tests when its predeclared gates pass.

ambiguities.question: What independent family holdout or generator variation prevents the target grammar, supplied resolver/candidate construction, and A0 certificates from being a bespoke adaptive-KV puzzle that favors the SELF prompt?
ambiguities.impact: Without it, success demonstrates performance on a tuned PCFL access protocol, not general offline compilation even within finite causal maps.

ambiguities.question: What quantitative decision rule, beyond reporting, limits or contextualizes unlimited/offline compiler samples, indexing, candidate enumeration, and latency relative to non-SELF baselines?
ambiguities.impact: Equal online bytes/calls cannot rule out a result purchased by materially unequal offline compute; no efficiency or learning-rate comparison is then warranted.

ambiguities.question: Can an eight-root DEV sample realistically pass normality/SD gates for P1, a minimum of 15 binary-derived contrasts with likely point masses, and can the 26-root t analysis retain stated size under completion failures?
ambiguities.impact: The nominal IUT controls a composite null conditional on valid component tests, but simulation scenarios may not cover the actual lattice/discrete distribution.

ambiguities.question: How will P4 distinguish a memory/compiler advantage from compounded differences in earlier policies and consequently different observed data, given each arm owns a different action-outcome history?
ambiguities.impact: P4 supports an end-to-end arm comparison; only the common-history sentinel localizes compiler representation, so language must not attribute P4 alone to DREAM.

ambiguities.question: What verified fleet, token/dollar cap, provider behavior, and measured per-root rates make even the eight-root DEV credible by the fixed dates?
ambiguities.impact: The current plan itself says no PCFL timing and no fresh inventory exist; September evidence may reasonably be design-only rather than construct-plus-DEV.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal describes the construct as sufficient to test an offline-compilation advantage.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: It repairs many shortcuts, but the strongest remaining alternative is a carefully engineered finite-world adaptive retrieval benchmark whose supplied renderer/extractor/candidates and frozen prompt jointly embody much of the useful representation. The proposed controls show that one record representation helps under these artifacts, not that dreaming supplies a generally useful learning mechanism.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, register an independent generator/skin/causal-graph holdout audit and a prompt/candidate-family leakage audit. If no such holdout is feasible, make the paper's title, abstract, and conclusion explicitly PCFL-protocol-specific and never a general self-learning-system claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal treats reporting all offline and online resources as adequate while comparing under a common online envelope.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: This is adequate for a narrowly stated value-under-online-budget result, but not for the directive's learning-rate or better-than-SOTA motivation. Offline enumeration, model sampling, candidate work, and latency can be the practical treatment.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Predefine a total-resource Pareto analysis and a bounded offline budget sensitivity analysis; withhold any efficiency, learning-rate, or practical superiority language unless both materially agree.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal presents .951579 marginal and .806317 dependence-free joint planning values as a sufficient confirmation design after frozen diagnostics/simulation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Those values follow from a normal-theory standardized-distance assumption, whereas P1 is the minimum of many failure-inclusive discrete contrasts and P2/P3 contain minima. Eight DEV roots have weak ability to validate tails or variance for those composites, and a scenario grid cannot prove coverage for unanticipated zero inflation or arm-specific failures.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require A0 exact distribution enumeration/simulation from the implemented scorer where possible, add a predeclared conservative randomization/permutation or exact alternative for applicable randomized P1 contrasts, and state that Stage C is confirmation only if the precommitted calibration gate passes; otherwise report descriptive results.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The six-arm surface and 3L sentinel are presented as sufficient baseline protection.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: They are much stronger than a weak-baseline comparison, but the exact program is a ceiling, AS-EXT is selected from only two designs, and the strongest common-history comparator uses a supplied known-good atom store unavailable in the ordinary end-to-end life. A reviewer can still ask whether a stronger ordinary recurrent/agent-memory system would close P4.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep P4 explicitly as superiority only to the named frozen envelope, publish the complete losing AS-EXT DEV results and resource policies, and add a predeclared ordinary-life recurrent/linked ablation if it can fit without changing the primary roster.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal offers a September construct-plus-eight-root-DEV evidence target.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The schedule itself bars confirmation before September 25 and has unmeasured PCFL rates, unverified fleet, a 256-fixture construct gate, an independent cognition review, and a full B0-B3 sequence. Even successful DEV is nonconfirmatory and cannot substantiate C1-C3.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Treat design-only as the default submission state; only describe DEV as labeled falsification/feasibility evidence if every planned gate and complete eight-root roster seals. Reserve all causal, continual-action, superiority, saturation, and A4/LoRA efficacy language for separately authorized confirmation.

open_questions: Whether to ratify only after resolving the five benchmark ambiguities and recording the narrower PCFL-protocol claim ceiling.
Whether future implementation authority may include a generator/holdout and total-resource sensitivity audit without changing the frozen primary confirmation roster.
Whether the independently reviewed A0-A2 artifacts, resource inventory, and exact scientific model-call scope justify any later Stage-B authority; this interpretation grants none.
